# The IMA ADPCM corpus: nibbles this project's model chose, and the
# samples ffmpeg's decoder makes of them.
#
# Generated out of tree by tools that are not dependencies of this
# repository, the same way testdata/ip/inflate_corpus.txt is. The
# `enc` line is what the reference algorithm in
# ip/audio/adpcm_ima/README.md picks, which is a *choice* an encoder
# is free to make differently. The `dec` line is what ffmpeg's
# decoder produces from exactly those nibbles, which is **not** a
# choice: it is the specified half, and it is the line that makes
# this corpus worth having.
#
# One record per case:
#   case  <name>
#   gen   <rule> <samples> <adler32 of the PCM, hex>
#   start <predictor> <step index>   -- the state encoding began at
#   enc   <the nibbles, packed two to a byte low nibble first, hex>
#   dec   <what ffmpeg decoded them back to, 16-bit LE, hex>
#
# The PCM is not stored: it is `pcm(rule, samples)` in
# tests/ip_library.rs, the same rule this generator used, and the
# adler32 is there so a rule that drifts is reported as a rule
# mismatch and not as a codec fault.
#
# Decoded by: ffmpeg version 8.1.2 Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers
